rationale: The interpreter introduced an unsupported ambiguity about rounding tie-breaking and supplied a resolution for it, even though the ticket does not define such an ambiguity. This constitutes an unsupported assumption that could affect implementation behavior.

findings.description: The interpreter adds an unsupported ambiguity about rounding tie-breaking and provides a resolution, although the ticket does not define such an ambiguity.
findings.action: Remove the invented ambiguity and its resolution; clarify tie-breaking policy with the ticket owner if needed.

sourceRefs.quote: If the entered value is not an exact multiple, round it to the nearest valid increment.
